name: Applicant Pipeline Report
query:
SELECT
    rr.name AS "Recruitment Request:Link/Recruitment Request:160",
    rr.position_title AS "Vị trí:Data:150",
    rr.department_ AS "Phòng ban:Link/Department:130",
    COUNT(ja.name) AS "Tổng số ứng viên:Int:120",
    SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'New' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "New:Int:80",
    SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'Screening' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Screening:Int:90",
    SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'Interview Scheduled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Interview Scheduled:Int:120",
    SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'Interviewing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Interviewing:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'Passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Passed:Int:80",
    SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'Rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Rejected:Int:80",
    SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'Offer Sent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Offer Sent:Int:90",
    SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'Offer Declined' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Offer Declined:Int:110",
    SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'Hired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Đã tuyển:Int:90",
    GREATEST(
        rr.number_of_employees -
        SUM(CASE WHEN ja.applicant_status = 'Hired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        0
    ) AS "Số lượng còn thiếu:Int:120"
FROM `tabRecruitment Request` rr
LEFT JOIN `tabJob Applicant` ja
    ON ja.recruitment_request = rr.name
GROUP BY
    rr.name,
    rr.position_title,
    rr.department_,
    rr.number_of_employees
ORDER BY rr.modified DESC
